jobs.title: Biomedical Scientist
jobs.description: Mission Neko Health is a health technology company that opened its first clinic in Stockholm in 2018, founded by Daniel Ek and Hjalmar Nilsonne. In one hour, our scan combines radiation-free imaging, heart and circulation measurements, and same-visit blood results with time to talk it through with a clinician, so people can act on what matters before symptoms appear. We design and build our own hardware, software and clinical protocols, and more than 100,000 members have already had a scan, with 75% booking and prepaying their next one before they leave. As a team, we chase 10X, not 10%, and we’re looking for people who think the same way to help us scale what we’ve started in Sweden, the UK, and now the US. Join the clinicians, engineers and business builders making prevention a routine part of care. Role Purpose This is not a traditional laboratory role. We're looking for a Biomedical Scientist who is comfortable working differently, embraces innovation, and takes pride in delivering accurate results at exceptional pace. Neko Health members come through our clinics for whole-body preventive health screenings, and our laboratories sit at the centre of the patient journey. They are busy, modern spaces, and the service continues to develop as we scale. This is a hands-on, autonomous role, based on site in one of our central London laboratories. As a Biomedical Scientist, you will operate our Abbott Alinity and Sysmex XN-550 analysers and support the quality systems that allow us to return results within 30 minutes of sample receipt. If you're a BMS looking to further develop your career in an innovation-led environment, we would love to hear from you. What You'll Deliver in the First 6 - 12 Months Initialise the analysers each day and ready them for sample processing. Perform testing on our Abbott Alinity (biochemistry and immunoassay) and Sysmex XN-550 (haematology) analysers, validating patient results and escalating clinically anomalous or unexpected findings. jobs.title: Psychotherapist
jobs.description: AthenaPsych is a New York State mental health-approved provider of community mental health services for children, adults, and families with behavioral and emotional challenges. We specialize in individual and group psychotherapy for clients with a focus on trauma-informed care. We are dedicated to improving the quality and accessibility of mental health care for all, especially individuals from underserved communities. Here at Athena, we pride ourselves on hiring a diverse group of mental health clinicians and staff who are passionate and dedicated to improving our clients’ overall emotional well-being. We provide both in-person and telehealth services for our clients and offer a competitive fee-for-service compensation plan and amazing benefits to our staff. We are a fee-for-service modeled clinic where therapists are paid per session completed. While this is a remote position, candidates must reside in or be willing to relocate to one of the following states prior to their start date: Colorado, Connecticut, District of Columbia (Washington, D.C.), Florida, Massachusetts, Maryland, North Carolina, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, Oregon, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Washington *Must be licensed in NY or open to obtaining NY credentials! jobs.title: Lab Automation Lead
jobs.description: About us, and our mission At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with a large cohort of patient-derived tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical outcomes, validate therapies and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we aim to make drug development smarter, faster and more personalized. We collaborate with leading hospitals, research institutes and pharmaceutical companies. Backed by leading investors, Orakl is a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of biology, automation and AI. Position overview Orakl runs a high-throughput 3D cell‑culture platform to culture patient-derived organoids (PDOs). These patient-derived specimens reveal critical information into the patient disease, but require heavy maintenance work. Automating these workflows will be critical to improve the reliability and traceability of experimental work. We are hiring our first automation lead to build the Automation function from scratch. This is a high ownership and high autonomy job. You will map our processes, decide what to automate and what to leave alone, specify and source the equipment, negotiate with vendors and integrators, commission the machines, run them with the lab team, and hire the people the function needs. As the ideal candidate, you have already put automated lines or special machines into service, and you know what typically breaks between commissioning and the first experimental runs. While previous experience in biology is a plus, it is not a strict requirement: you will be taught all you need to know. jobs.title: Senior Clinical Trials Systems Manager
jobs.description: Â POSITION SUMMARY: Job Function: Clinical Operations Title: Senior Clinical Trial Systems Lead The Senior Clinical Trials Systems Lead serves as the business owner representative for Clinical Operations systems, such as CTMS and eTMF. This role defines business problems and intended use, facilitates the prioritization for system updates and enhancements, coordinates handoff to IT and product partners, reviews designs and prototypes iteratively, and coordinates user acceptance testing and go-live approval. This individual will work in partnership with IS&T, Product, UI/UX, QA, Training, and the vendors who design, build, and validate outsourced systems. The role is also the day-to-day business point of contact for users and cross-functional teams, supporting troubleshooting, and continuous system improvements. The Senior Clinical Trials Systems Lead helps ensure that systems meet the requirements of study protocols, regulatory standards, business objectives, and user needs, and are fit for their intended use. Â PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES: Partner directly with clinical science, quality, and regulatory teams to plan, test, and deploy new clinical systems and enhancements. Support system compliance with FDA, EMA, and ICH-GCP standards by defining GxP impact for all changes. Work closely with IS&T, QA, and product teams to manage system integrations, upgrades, and vendor service levels. Document stakeholder requirements clearly, identify process gaps, and propose actionable solutions. Review system designs and prototypes iteratively, providing fast, direct feedback. Coordinate and execute user acceptance testing (UAT), documenting results to provide final business sign-off. Serve as the primary functional support contact for internal teams, troubleshooting issues and escalating technical blockers to IS&T.
